notes.title: Unhack 2 feature list
notes.content:
Hi there :neonya:! Now that [i]Unhack 2[/i] has been released, I would like to share with you some of the features available:

* * *

[img]http://i.imgur.com/A53lj1zh.jpg[/img]

[b]A more mature story:[/b]

[i]Unhack 1[/i] was created in 2012, so as a student of the craft, I like to think my skills have improved since then. I am, of course, also a bit older now. While [i]Unhack 2[/i]’s characters are still an energetic bunch, I believe the cast goes through more of a mature journey this time around.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gfWvzFXh.jpg[/img]

[b]Exploring the human VS AI dilemma:[/b]

AI will play a bigger role as the years go on, so this is a good time to explore some of the questions involved. What does it mean to be human, anyway? Is it possible for AI to understand how it feels to be us? I fell in love with the topic during my research for this sequel, to an extent where I would like to explore these issues again in the future. To avoid being preachy, [i]Unhack 2[/i] is still very much entertainment first.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xdhBG9bh.jpg[/img]

[b]Puzzle gameplay:[/b]

While story takes the lead this time, puzzle gameplay does make a return in [i]Unhack 2[/i]. In the original game, players had to constantly pause between slots to read the dialogue, which in retrospect was not the best mix of narrative and gameplay. This is why the elements are separated in [i]Unhack 2[/i]. I want to explore other methods in future games, so I hope we can go through this journey together.

Though the puzzles are smaller in scale this time, they are in some ways more complex. Let’s see if unhackers are ready for the challenge. Please note the puzzles can be skipped for those who wish to focus on the narrative.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ULWOrmeh.jpg[/img]

[b]More art featuring Rosuuri:[/b]

My budget and experience were limited back in [i]Unhack 1[/i], so I was unable to feature the number of artworks I really wanted. In this sequel, I am able to showcase more illustrations (most of which contain spoilers, which is why they are not shown on this page). Our artist this time is Rosuuri. Her works are well-known in the community, and since she is one of the best around, there is a good reason for that.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sUEDTkFh.jpg[/img]

[b]3D-rendered backgrounds:[/b]

Due to budget constraints in [i]Unhack 1[/i], I was unable to include proper background illustrations. Helen “Tayola” Schwieger is our 3D background artist in [i]Unhack 2[/i], and she has put together a collection of renders for us to enjoy throughout the game. These 3D backdrops fit our digital theme nicely.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/pA1shlyh.jpg[/img]

[b]Brainfed returns as the composer:[/b]

([i]Unhack 1[/i] album art by Hybridmink)

Brainfed (Matt Hamm) provided a fitting soundtrack for us in [i]Unhack 1[/i]. He has graciously given his time again for [i]Unhack 2[/i], and thanks to him, this sequel contains another soundtrack that belongs in the [i]Unhack[/i] universe. Several tracks may even include nostalgic references to the original title.

* * *

[i]Unhack 2[/i] can be purchased here:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/444170/Unhack_2/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/444170/Unhack_2[/url]
And, of course, the original:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/340800/Unhack/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/340800/Unhack[/url]
Thank you everyone :whappy:!

notes.title: Japanese translation patch released for Unhack
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/MRGDxBn.png][/img]

Hello everyone. kagerou01gata over in Japan has kindly translated Unhack into Japanese for us! The patch is available [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/rgzqlqnewqa46cp/Unhack1%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%AA%9E%E5%8C%96%E3%83%91%E3%83%83%E3%83%81rev1.zip?dl=0]here[/url].

[img=http://i.imgur.com/xaTBj1n.png][/img]

Without Within 1 and 2 were both translated by paid companies, so this is the first fan translation I have received, and I am really grateful for it. We are living in such a wonderful era, where gamers are able to support one another like this.

Thank you so much ːweedyː!
